rubrics.justification: Core grading is broadly consistent with the provided 3AB label and visible expanded blastocyst with thinned zona, but the response over-interprets image details such as debris, granularity, and focal TE irregularity that are not clearly reliable from this single image.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, diagnosis, endometrium, sperm data, and first-cycle status well with embryo quality, though some links are overstated or speculative.
The reasoning is structured and mostly internally consistent, and the implantation estimate follows the overall favorable profile, but several modifiers are weakly supported and somewhat arbitrary.

Most recommendations are broadly standard (SET, luteal support, no ERA in first cycle), but suggestions such as routine PGT-A after one failure, thrombophilia/immunologic testing, and lifestyle claims about stress/alcohol/BMI are not strongly guideline-based for this case.

Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer technique, luteal support, and contingency planning, though some future workup items are more aggressive than necessary for a first uncomplicated cycle.
